The H15 Dual is $999, ships November 14, 2026 — Bitcoin and Dogecoin in one box. It draws for a full block every ten minutes, year after year, and stacks sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual numbers for where you live.
